The TASK deck: small personal deeds a hero does on the way to everything else, and the second of the two ways a hero earns DEEDS toward their next level (rules.json level.deeds) - the first is quests (quests.json). A quest is offered, read aloud and accepted or declined; a task is dealt to you, kept face down beside your board, and nobody else knows what you are trying to do. That is the whole difference, and it is why they are a deck of their own rather than a fourth kind of quest.

Every player holds `hand` task at a time. One is dealt at setup; when you do it, take its deeds, put it at the bottom of the deck and draw the next. A task you do not like can be swapped at any inn for `swap.coin`, which buys a rumour of something better and costs no renown, because nobody knew you had promised anything.

A task that names a TEST is passed by a d6 plus the characteristic named against the number printed (rules.json test). Most of them test Wisdom, which is what drink takes away (rules.json drink) - so the inn that makes a hero good company is the same inn that makes them bad at their tasks, and that is the trade the wineskin is there to offer.

The deeds a task prints are 1 to 3. A mini quest is worth its complexity, 1 to 3, and a campaign stage 4 or 5: so a task is about a mini quest's worth, and the deck is there to keep a hero who drew no quests from standing still. Card codes TSK-nn. The deck is in the mint queue and its briefs are in docs/art/prompts/tasks.md; the rulebook, the annex and the explorer print every card in full.

swap.note: Put your task at the bottom of the deck and draw another. A task is a private promise.

tasks.name: Read the Old Stones
tasks.hook: Somebody cut letters into the hilltop stones before anybody here could read. Somebody else has been rubbing them out.
tasks.task: End a leg on a hills or mountain hex and pass the test.

tasks.name: The Herbalist's Question
tasks.hook: Three remedies on the stall, one of them is chalk, and the woman selling them wants to know if you can tell which.
tasks.task: In any settlement with a market, pass the test.

tasks.name: Three Countries
tasks.hook: A cartographer in Vossgard pays by the sketch, but only for ground you have stood on.
tasks.task: End legs on three different kinds of terrain, in three different rounds.

tasks.name: A Bed in Every Inn
tasks.hook: The innkeepers keep a book of the people who are worth a bed. You are not in it yet.

tasks.name: Cross the Sand
tasks.hook: Everybody says the short way is through the dunes. Nobody says it twice.
tasks.task: End two legs in a row on desert hexes, and end the second with your Thirst below its limit.

tasks.name: Talk It Down
tasks.hook: Anything with teeth can be killed. The trick worth a song is the other one.

tasks.name: Hold the Road
tasks.hook: The carters have stopped using the east road, and the thing that stopped them is still on it.
tasks.task: Win a battle against a monster whose strength is 5 or more.

tasks.name: Sober Counsel
tasks.hook: Two families, one well, and a magistrate who has sent for whoever is passing.
tasks.task: In any settlement, pass the test - with no drink since you last slept.

tasks.name: The Long Haul
tasks.hook: The best price is always somewhere else. Today it is six days off.
tasks.task: Deliver a cargo to a settlement six or more hexes from where it was loaded, and sell it there.

tasks.name: A Round for the House
tasks.hook: Nobody remembers a hero. Everybody remembers who paid.
tasks.task: At any inn, buy a cup for every figure there - at least three - and drink one yourself.

tasks.name: The Hermit's Riddle
tasks.hook: He lives in the deep wood, he will answer one question, and he asks one first.
tasks.task: End a leg on a forest hex and pass the test. Fail it, and your next leg starts a round late.

tasks.name: Keep Your Word
tasks.hook: Anybody can take a job. The ones people talk about are the ones who finish fast.
tasks.task: Complete a quest within three rounds of accepting it.
